EN:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}You're acting kind of obsessed with
me.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Which is totally understandable,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Just take a deep breath,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} and tell me
what you need.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Hé hé ! Mais ma parole, tu me cours
après on dirait.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Remarque, je peux
comprendre,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bon, reprends ton souffle{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} et dis-moi
ce que tu me veux.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}La tua è quasi un'ossessione nei
miei confronti.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Del resto, come
darti torto, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Su, respira a fondo{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} e dimmi cosa
ti serve.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Bana biraz fazla taktın sanki.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Gerçi

bir nefes al,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} sonra ne istediğini söyle.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm a chill guy.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Even if you want to
talk to me a million times, I won't
run away screaming or anything.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}So{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} what can I do for you,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Soy un tío tranqui.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Por eso no voy
a salir huyendo aunque quieras
darme la chapa un millón de veces.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bueno,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿y qué te cuentas,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je suis du genre communicatif.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Si tu veux me parler, c'est quand tu
veux, autant de fois que tu veux.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Alors,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tu veux me dire quoi cette
fois, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sono un pacioccone.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Puoi rivolgermi

non mi stancherei mai di ascoltarti.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Beh,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} cosa posso fare per te,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich bin ein ruhiger Typ.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Auf jeden
Fall renne ich nicht schreiend weg,
wenn mir jemand nachläuft.
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Also,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} worum geht es dieses Mal,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
TRANSLATION:
